title: Codefly dashboard catalog
description: The dashboard components @codefly-dev/ui/dashboard renders, as an A2UI catalog. Generated from the kit's own types.
instructions:
- Every component here is drawn by `@codefly-dev/ui/dashboard`. This catalog publishes the names and their properties; the kit owns the drawing.
- Data is bound by reference. A `data` or `series` property carries a data-model pointer and the catalog carries no values — the shapes those pointers resolve to are `codefly-dev.ui:dashboard-data/v1`.
- A widget's visualization is one of: `line`, `bar`, `area`, `number`, `table`. `line` → `MetricLineChart`, `bar` → `MetricBarChart`, `area` → `MetricAreaChart`, `number` → `StatTile`. `table` is drawn only inside `Dashboard`, from its view, and has no standalone component to name.
- `Dashboard` draws one resolved view whole; `DashboardGrid` lays out charts declared one by one. Both are valid roots.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description: A whole resolved dashboard: one `DashboardView` from codefly-dev.ui:dashboard-data/v1, bound by pointer. Its widgets travel in the data model, not as child components, so a renderer holding this one component draws every widget the view declares.

DashboardGrid.title: DashboardGrid
DashboardGrid.description: A grid of chart components. Use it when each chart is declared and refreshed on its own; use Dashboard when one resolved view is drawn whole.

MetricLineChart.title: MetricLineChart
MetricLineChart.description: One metric as a line. `series` points at that metric's resolved `SeriesPoint[]`.

MetricAreaChart.title: MetricAreaChart
MetricAreaChart.description: One metric as a filled area. `series` points at that metric's resolved `SeriesPoint[]`.

MetricBarChart.title: MetricBarChart
MetricBarChart.description: One metric as bars, one per group. `series` points at that metric's resolved `SeriesPoint[]`.

StatTile.title: StatTile
StatTile.description: One metric as a scalar, with its points behind it. `total` is the scalar; a null total is unavailable, not zero.
